body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Rosemary Beach "The Sanctuary" 18 New Providence Lane Main House Rosemary Beach, FL Bedrooms 3 Beds 11 Sleeps 14 Full Baths 4 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Located South of 30A - Short walk to the beach - Access to 4 neighborhood pools - Access to fitness center and racquet club - Private pool - Outdoor kitchen - Open floor plan - Professionally decorated - 3 adult bikes - Tesla charging station in garage - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: The Sanctuary is a south-of-30A, 3-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom Rosemary Beach home that sleeps 14. Guests will love the short walk to the beach, the home’s wide wrap-around balcony, and the private courtyard that includes a fireplace, outdoor kitchen, and pool. Guests enter into an open living, dining, and kitchen area with exposed timber ceiling beams, a tile floor, and a refined coastal aesthetic. A white and bright gourmet kitchen has premium appliances, a Thermador 4-burner gas range with a griddle, and gorgeous Calcutta marble countertops that lead to an adjacent butler’s pantry with additional storage. Windows and French doors wrap around the living and dining area, filling the space with natural light. A bedroom is tucked off the living area. Guests can recline on a wraparound sofa and watch TV, and enjoy music on the SONOS sound system. Guests will love this private oasis! They can relax in the shade of a covered porch or step down to a landscaped courtyard. A stone walkway connects a dining area to a luxurious outdoor kitchen with a marble counter, a gas grill, 2 gas cooktops, and a stand-alone ice maker. On the home’s second floor, a primary and a guest bedroom enjoy private access to a wraparound balcony with views of the courtyard and surrounding Rosemary Beach. Guests who need to combine work with their time at the beach have 2 built-in desks off the laundry room to choose from. An open loft living area on the third floor gives guests sleeping in one of the 6 twin beds or 2 trundles a place to lounge before drifting off to sleep. Guests can easily explore Rosemary Beach on 3 included adult bikes. The Racquet Club, 4 community pools, restaurants, shopping, and a fitness center are all within short walking distance. With its wonderful courtyard and south-of-30A location, The Sanctuary will book quickly. Please call 360 Blue today to secure your next 30A beach escape!
